concepts.title: Area of a Rectangle
concepts.definition: Flat region a rectangle covers: adjacent sides multiplied.
concepts.key_idea: Product of the two adjacent perpendicular sides.
question_patterns: find the area of a rectangle with length and width
what is the area of a rectangular field of dimensions
calculate the area of a rectangle
how much space does a rectangle of length and width cover
A 12 by 8 sheet -- coverage?

solution_steps.explain: The area of a rectangle is the product of its length and width.
Area is measured in square units, so the result carries the squared unit of the given length and width.
Report the computed area with the correct squared unit as the coverage of the rectangle.

concepts.title: Area of a Triangle
concepts.definition: A triangle's coverage: half of base x upright height.
concepts.key_idea: It is half a rectangle on the same base and upright.
question_patterns: find the area of a triangle with base and height
calculate the area of a triangle
what is the area of a triangle whose base is and height is
how to compute the area of a triangle given base and altitude
Base 8, height 5 -- coverage?

solution_steps.explain: First find the product of the base and the height.
The area is half of the product of base and height.
Report the computed area with the correct squared unit as the coverage of the triangle.

concepts.title: Area of a General Quadrilateral
concepts.definition: Cut any four-sided field along a slant; total the two triangles' coverages.
concepts.key_idea: One slant splits it into a pair of triangles leaning on the same cut.
question_patterns: find the area of field ABCD given slant AC and the two upright gaps
find the area of a quadrilateral with diagonal and perpendiculars
calculate the area of quadrilateral ABCD where AC is and offsets are
what is the area of a quadrilateral with diagonal and heights
Slant 10 with gaps 5 and 3 -- coverage?
Split quadrilateral PQRS along QS -- total the two triangles.

solution_steps.explain: Add the two heights or perpendicular offsets from the remaining vertices to the diagonal.
Multiply the sum of offsets by the diagonal length and divide by 2.
Report the computed area with the correct squared unit as the coverage of the quadrilateral.

concepts.title: Area of a Parallelogram
concepts.definition: Sliding-sided shape's coverage: base x perpendicular height.
concepts.key_idea: Reshape it by shearing; base and height stay put.
question_patterns: Frame a parallelogram task like the chapter exercise and solve it with every step shown.
calculate the area of a parallelogram with base and height
what is the area of a parallelogram whose base is and height is
Base 12, height 7 -- coverage?
A sliding-sided floor has base 15 and height 9 -- coverage?

solution_steps.explain: The area of a parallelogram is base times height.
Ensure the height used is the perpendicular distance between the base and its opposite side, not a slant side.
Report the computed area with the correct squared unit as the coverage of the parallelogram.

concepts.title: Area of a Rhombus
concepts.definition: All-equal-sided shape's coverage: half x slant x other slant.
concepts.key_idea: The two cuts cross at right corners; four half-triangles result.
question_patterns: find the area of a rhombus with diagonals
calculate the area of a rhombus
what is the area of a rhombus whose diagonals are
Slants 16 and 12 -- coverage?
Diagonals 20 and 15 -- coverage of the equal-sided shape?

solution_steps.explain: Find the product of the two diagonals.
The area is half the product of the diagonals.
Report the computed area with the correct squared unit as the coverage of the rhombus.

concepts.title: Area of a Trapezium
concepts.definition: One matched pair of sides: half x (their sum) x the gap between them.
concepts.key_idea: Mean of the matched pair times the perpendicular gap.
question_patterns: find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides and height
calculate the area of a trapezium
what is the area of a trapezium whose parallel sides are and distance is
Matched sides 12 and 8, gap 4 -- coverage?
Matched sides 14 and 10 stand 6 apart -- coverage?

solution_steps.explain: Add the lengths of the two parallel sides.
Multiply the sum of parallel sides by the height and divide by 2.
Report the computed area with the correct squared unit as the coverage of the trapezium.

concepts.title: Area Unit Conversion (Square Inches to Square Centimeters)
concepts.definition: Converting area from square inches to square centimeters by multiplying by the conversion factor 6.4516.
concepts.key_idea: Since 1 inch equals 2.54 cm, 1 square inch equals 2.54 squared square centimeters.
question_patterns: convert square inches to square centimeters
how many square centimeters is square inches
calculate the area in square cm given square inches
Convert 4 sq in to sq cm.
Convert 10 sq in to sq cm.

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the area in square inches by 6.4516 to convert to square centimeters.
The factor 6.4516 comes from squaring 2.54 cm per inch, since area scales with the square of the length unit.
Report the computed area in square centimeters as the converted coverage.

concepts.title: Finding Altitude using Area Equivalence
concepts.definition: Determining an unknown altitude of a triangle by equating two different expressions for its area using two different base-altitude pairs.
concepts.key_idea: The coverage stays fixed whichever side you call the base.
question_patterns: find the length of altitude BY given base AC, base BC, and altitude AX
calculate the unknown altitude of a triangle using another base and altitude
what is the height of a triangle with base when another base and height are
Base 6 upright 4; base 8 -- its upright?
Base 15 carries upright 8; along base 10 -- its upright?

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the known base and its corresponding altitude.
Divide the double area by the second base to find the corresponding altitude.
Report the computed altitude with the correct length unit as the unknown height on the second base.
